technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with golden cross and new highs, but overbought conditions (RSI 9: 70.92, Stoch: 91.99) and negative MACD histogram create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dip than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 39 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for ACN; mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases) lacks conviction, broad market neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (79.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 39 days adds event risk but not imminent; unfavourable risk/reward for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above all major MAs and new 20-day highs establish strong uptrend structure that historically precedes continuation moves.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 70.92, Stoch 91.99), bearish MACD histogram, VIX crisis levels (79.7), inverted yield curve, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 39 days create asymmetric downside risk with limited margin of safety.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows golden cross and new highs, but entry quality is moderate with price near resistance and extreme overbought conditions limiting risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (79.7), inverted yield curve, and earnings event in 39 days create macro headwinds that could trigger sharp pullback from overbought technicals with zero fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position with 18 existing IT sector positions (38% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure.
